basis: 16 logical CPUs available via os.process_cpu_count; no network
worker_adapter: same R worker text with only outer loop replaced by specified replicate index
retention: one immutable directory per outer sample; aggregate after all jobs finish
validation_rule: original maximum 200 replicates per cell; no early acceptance; development source hashes checked before launch
futility: before any validation results: after each completed outer sample, if even all remaining candidate samples covered and valid cannot meet full planned N=200 coverage/Wilson/success thresholds in one noninformative cell, stop scheduling new work; active jobs finish; status stopped_futility (never completed validation); retain partial denominators and optimistic full-N bound
